disputes.topic: Exact source acquisition and registration inputs are not reproducible
disputes.issue: The README notes that the packet mixes KITTI Odometry sequence references with a raw-drive identifier and that the exact acquisition has not been established. Raw point-cloud scans, calibration/pose files and reproducible registration logs are absent.
evidence: README.txt: source reference and verification limits
OI.json: source_provenance scan and pose references
snapshot/manifest.json: no source scan or pose evidence
disputes.required_resolution: Identify the exact source acquisition and supply/durably reference the matching scans, calibration, poses and registration log. Reconcile the raw-drive and Odometry sequence references before claiming a reproduced map.

disputes.issue: OI records a moving-car candidate as a registration conflict; MSRM describes it as excluded or temporally labelled, but the retained files do not demonstrate which points were excluded or how the conflict was resolved.
evidence: dispute.json legacy note previously described this as a non-blocking candidate
disputes.required_resolution: Retain the source scan/time evidence and the actual SemanticKITTI/velocity filtering decision, or preserve the affected region as unresolved and exclude it from the static assembled map. Do not claim a clean static map until resolved.
